<thought>Construct a retrosynthetic tree with five sequential reactions that lead from simple, commercially available precursors to the target molecule. The steps are: (1) protect a primary alcohol as a TBS ether, (2) reduce an ester to the corresponding aldehyde with DIBAL‑H, (3) perform a Still‑Gennari Horner‑Wadsworth‑Emmons olefination to introduce the (Z)‑alkene and ester functionality, (4) hydrolyse the ester to the carboxylic acid, and (5) remove the TBS protecting group to give the final product. The JSON follows the required schema.</thought>
<final_answer>{
  "type": "mol",
  "smiles": "O[C@H]1C[C@@H](O[C@@H]([C@@H]1C)/C=C(CO)/C)C/C=C/C=C/C(O)=O",
  "children": [
    {
      "type": "reaction",
      "template_id": "deprotect_TBS",
      "children": [
        {
          "type": "mol",
          "smiles": "O[C@H]1C[C@@H](O[TBDMS][C@@H]([C@@H]1C)/C=C(CO)/C)C/C=C/C=C/C(O)=O"
        },
        {
          "type": "mol",
          "smiles": "[F-].[N+](C(C)(C)C)(C(C)(C)C)C"  // TBAF (tetra‑n‑butylammonium fluoride)
        }
      ]
    },
    {

        },
        {
          "type": "mol",
          "smiles": "Na[OH]"  // aqueous NaOH
        }
      ]
    },
    {

        },
        {
          "type": "mol",
          "smiles": "COC(=O)P(=O)(OCCF)OCCF"  // typical Still‑Gennari phosphonate ester
        }
      ]
    },
    {

        {
          "type": "mol",

        },
        {

      ]
    },
    {

        },
        {
          "type": "mol",
